intro.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Hisaabii is a Saudi Arabia / GCC-focused SaaS platform for ZATCA-oriented invoicing and business management. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share information when you use our web and mobile applications and related services (the “Service”).
By creating an account or using the Service, you acknowledge the practices described here. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

collect.title: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: Account and profile data: name, email address, password (stored hashed), language preference, and similar account settings.
Business profile data: company names, VAT/tax identifiers, commercial registration details, addresses, logos, stamps, signatures, bank details you choose to store, and related onboarding information.

Operational and financial records you create in the Service: clients/vendors, products and services, invoices and related documents (quotations, proposals, credit/debit notes, delivery notes, and similar), payments, expenses, HR and project records, uploaded files and OCR/document inputs, and activity logs tied to your workspace.
Technical and usage data: device/browser information, IP address, approximate location derived from IP, cookies or similar technologies, and diagnostic logs needed to operate and secure the Service.
Billing data: subscription plan, billing cycle, and payment status. Card details are collected and processed by Moyasar; Hisaabii does not store full card numbers on its servers.

use.title: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to provide and improve the Service: authentication, workspace management, invoicing and document generation, ZATCA-related workflows you initiate, notifications, support, security monitoring, fraud prevention, and billing.
We may use aggregated or de-identified information that cannot reasonably identify you for analytics and product improvement.

processors.title: 4. Third-party processors we use
paragraphs: Moyasar — payment processing and subscription billing (including trials and receipts Moyasar generates for charges).
Hostinger email (SMTP) — transactional email delivery (for example OTP codes, invitations, billing notices, and document emails you send through the Service).
Hosting, database, and infrastructure providers that run the application environment. We require processors to handle data only as needed to provide their services to us.

Where you connect or submit data to ZATCA / Fatoora (or related official systems) through features we provide, those systems are operated by the relevant authorities under their own terms; we facilitate the technical flow you request.

retention.title: 5. Data retention
paragraphs: We retain account and business data while your account and companies remain active, and for a reasonable period afterward to meet legal, accounting, dispute, and security needs.

Invoice and related tax records may be subject to Saudi / ZATCA regulatory retention obligations that apply to your business. Those obligations are yours as the taxpayer; the Service stores records you create so you can operate and demonstrate compliance, but retention requirements for tax documents are not waived by deleting an app account alone. Contact us if you need an export before closing a workspace.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies for session authentication, security, locale preferences, and essential product operation. Disabling essential cookies may prevent login or core features from working.

rights.title: 7. Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data we hold about you, or object to certain processing. Workspace owners can also update most business and user data directly in the product.
Some records cannot be fully erased where we must retain them for legal, regulatory, billing, or security reasons. We will explain limitations when you make a request.

security.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect information (including access controls, encryption in transit, and monitoring). No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; you are responsible for protecting account credentials and limiting access within your organization.

children.title: 9. Children’s privacy
paragraphs: The Service is intended for business users and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will revise the “Last updated” date and, when changes are material, provide additional notice through the Service or email where appropriate.

contact.title: 11. Contact
paragraphs: Privacy questions: privacy@hisaabii.com (placeholder — replace with your real contact before publishing as final policy).
If you are in Saudi Arabia or another GCC jurisdiction, include any locally required contact or complaint channels once your counsel finalizes this document.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern access to and use of Hisaabii, a SaaS platform for invoicing and business management oriented to Saudi Arabia and the GCC, including ZATCA-related features (the “Service”).
By creating an account, starting a trial, subscribing, or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms on behalf of yourself and any organization you represent.

service.title: 2. Description of the service
paragraphs: Hisaabii provides tools for company workspaces, client and product catalogs, invoicing and related commercial documents, finance and operations modules enabled by your plan, client portal access where configured, and workflows that help you prepare and submit ZATCA-related invoice data when you choose to use those features.

Features available to you depend on your subscription plan (for example Starter or Pro), module entitlements, and configuration. We may improve, add, or remove features with reasonable notice when material.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts and responsibilities
paragraphs: You must provide accurate registration information and keep credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your accounts and for authorizing only appropriate users within your organization.
You must ensure that business data you enter (including VAT numbers, addresses, and invoice content) is accurate and lawful. You must not misuse the Service or attempt unauthorized access.

billing.title: 4. Subscriptions, trials, and billing
paragraphs: Paid access is offered through subscription plans such as Starter and Pro, billed via Moyasar on the cycle you select (for example monthly or yearly), subject to the pricing shown at checkout.

Where a free trial is offered, card details may be collected up front through Moyasar; unless you cancel before the trial ends under the rules shown in the product, the subscription may convert to a paid plan and your payment method may be charged.

Fees are generally non-refundable except where required by law or expressly stated otherwise. Failed payments may result in immediate lockout of modules until billing is restored, as implemented in the product.
Taxes may apply based on your location. You authorize us and Moyasar to charge the payment method on file for recurring amounts.

acceptableUse.title: 5. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You may use the Service only for lawful business purposes. You must not upload malware, infringe others’ rights, spam, attempt to reverse engineer the Service except as permitted by law, or use the Service to violate tax, privacy, or export rules.
We may suspend or terminate access for violations, abuse, or risk to the platform or other customers.

ownership.title: 6. Data ownership and license
paragraphs: You retain ownership of the business content and records you submit to the Service (“Customer Data”). You grant Hisaabii a limited license to host, process, transmit, and display Customer Data solely to provide and improve the Service and as otherwise described in the Privacy Policy.
Hisaabii and its licensors retain all rights in the Service software, branding, and documentation. These Terms do not transfer ownership of our intellectual property to you.

zatca.title: 7. ZATCA and tax compliance disclaimer
paragraphs: Hisaabii provides software features intended to help you prepare, validate, and submit electronic invoices and related data in workflows aligned with ZATCA requirements. The Service facilitates technical steps you initiate; it does not replace your legal obligations as a taxpayer or business.

You remain solely responsible for the accuracy of invoice data, timely filing and clearance/reporting as required, choice of environment (for example simulation vs production), certificate and OTP handling, and overall tax compliance under Saudi law and any other applicable rules. We do not provide tax, legal, or accounting advice.

liability.title: 8. Disclaimers and limitation of liability
paragraphs: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED “AS IS” AND “AS AVAILABLE” TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW. WE DISCLAIM WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT, EXCEPT WHERE SUCH DISCLAIMERS ARE NOT ALLOWED.

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, HISABII AND ITS SUPPLIERS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR LOST PROFITS, REVENUE, DATA, OR GOODWILL. OUR AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THESE TERMS OR THE SERVICE WILL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNTS YOU PAID TO US FOR THE SERVICE IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM.
Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations; in those cases our liability is limited to the fullest extent permitted.

termination.title: 9. Suspension and termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the Service and cancel a subscription according to the billing controls in the product (Settings → Billing).

We may suspend or terminate access for non-payment, breach of these Terms, legal risk, or discontinuation of the Service. Upon termination, your right to use the Service ends; we may delete or retain Customer Data as described in the Privacy Policy and applicable law.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts in Saudi Arabia shall have exclusive jurisdiction, except where mandatory consumer or local rules require otherwise.

changes.title: 11. Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will update the “Last updated” date and may notify you through the Service or email for material changes. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

contact.title: 12. Contact

otpHelp.title: How to get your OTP from Fatoora
otpHelp.intro: Follow these steps on the official ZATCA Fatoora portal, then come back here and paste the 6-digit code.
otpHelp.step1: Open the Fatoora portal and sign in with your ERAD credentials (your TIN or registered email, and password).
otpHelp.step2: On the portal's main page, click the "Onboard new solution unit/device" tile.
otpHelp.step3: Click "Generate OTP code" and enter the number of OTP codes you need (1 is enough for Hisaabii).
otpHelp.step4: Copy the 6-digit OTP shown on the portal, or download it.
otpHelp.step5: Return to this screen, paste the OTP into the field above, and click Connect to ZATCA.
otpHelp.otpValidityNote: Each OTP is valid for 1 hour and can only be used once. If it expires before you connect, generate a new one on the Fatoora portal and try again.

ProductTour.offerTitle: Want a quick tour of Hisabi POS?
ProductTour.offerBody: We will walk you through the modules you can access — restaurants, POS, menu, invoices, HR, reports, and settings — so you can get productive faster.
ProductTour.finishBody: You can replay this tour anytime from Settings → Profile.
ProductTour.dashboardBody: Your home base for today’s sales, alerts, and quick links into the areas you use most.
ProductTour.restaurantsListBody: See every restaurant linked to your account, check ZATCA status, and open the one you need.
ProductTour.restaurantsCreateBody: Create another restaurant when you run more than one location. Each restaurant keeps its own menu, invoices, and settings.
ProductTour.restaurantsSwitcherBody: Use this switcher to choose which restaurant you are working in. The active restaurant controls the data you see across the app.
ProductTour.posBody: Open the POS to take orders, take payments, and issue ZATCA-ready simplified tax invoices.
ProductTour.menuListBody: Browse and manage the dishes and items your restaurant sells on the POS.
ProductTour.menuAddBody: Add a new dish or item with Arabic and English names, price, VAT, and optional image.
ProductTour.menuCategoriesBody: Organize menu items into categories so cashiers can find them quickly on the POS.
ProductTour.invoicesListBody: Review every sale invoice, check ZATCA status, print receipts, and open a document for details.
ProductTour.creditNotesBody: Issue credit notes against invoices when you need to refund or correct a reported sale.
ProductTour.debitNotesBody: Issue debit notes when you need to increase amounts on a related invoice under ZATCA rules.
ProductTour.hrEmployeesBody: Manage staff profiles, roles, and documents for this restaurant.
ProductTour.hrPayslipCategoriesBody: Define earning and deduction categories used when building salary slips.
ProductTour.hrSalarySlipsBody: Create and manage payroll slips for your team.
ProductTour.hrEmployeePaymentsBody: Record salary payments and advances against employees.
ProductTour.hrVisaStatusBody: Track visa expiry dates so you can renew before staff status lapses.
ProductTour.reportsBody: Expand Reports for sales, tax, cashier, ZATCA, HR, and other summaries you are allowed to view.
ProductTour.settingsBody: Open Settings to update your profile — name, language, notifications, and password.
ProductTour.settingsBodyAdmin: Open Settings for your profile, restaurant identity and defaults, and data export tools.
